WorkItem.title: WorkItem
WorkItem.description: Represents a work item in the workflow management system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WorkItem entity.

process.description: The type of process for the work item.

assignedTo.description: Reference to User who is assigned to this work item.

urgency.description: The urgency level of the work item.

status.description: The current status of the work item.

subject.description: A brief subject or title for the work item.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the work item was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the work item was last updated.

overview.description: A detailed description of the work item.

lockInfo.description: Information about who has locked the work item for editing.

userId.description: The UID of the user who locked the item.

userName.description: The display name of the user who locked the item.

timestamp.description: The ISO timestamp of when the lock was acquired.

ImageAttachment.title: ImageAttachment
ImageAttachment.description: Represents an image file attached to a work item.

workItemId.description: The ID of the work item it belongs to.

url.description: The data URL of the uploaded image.

fileName.description: The name of the uploaded file.

uploadedAt.description: The timestamp of when the image was uploaded.

uploadedBy.description: The UID of the user who uploaded the image.

type.description: The type of document (e.g., EMAIL, CORR, QUOTE).

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

department.description: The department the user belongs to.

jobTitle.description: The user's job title or position.

level.description: The user's level in the organization.

company.description: The company the user works for.

role.description: The user's role in the system.

Note.title: Note
Note.description: Represents a note associated with a work item.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Note entity.

workItemId.description: Reference to the WorkItem this note belongs to.

authorId.description: Reference to the User who created the note.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the note was created.

category.description: The category of the action taken (e.g., Closed, Terminated, Re-indexed).

subject.description: A specific subject line for the note or action.

GlobalNote.title: GlobalNote
GlobalNote.description: Represents a general note associated with a customer, not tied to a specific work item.

customerUniqueId.description: The unique ID of the customer this note is about.

authorId.description: The UID of the user who wrote the note.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Represents a customer with a unique ID.

Counter.title: Counter
Counter.description: A document to store a counter value for atomic increments.

count.description: The current value of the counter.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles. Path-based ownership ensures only the user (or an admin) can access their profile. User's role is stored within this document.

/customers/{customerId}.description: Stores unique customer information, keyed by email, to maintain a single unique ID per customer.

/work_items/{workitemId}.description: Stores work items. Access is controlled by the 'assignedTo' field.

/work_items/{workitemId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Stores notes associated with a specific work item. Access is inherited from the parent work item.

/work_items/{workitemId}/attachments/{at.description: Stores image attachments for a specific work item. Access is inherited.

/global_notes/{globalNoteId}.description: Stores general notes about a customer, not tied to a specific work item.

/counters/user_employee_id.description: Stores the counter for generating unique employee IDs for users.

/counters/customer_unique_id.description: Counter for generating unique sequential IDs for customers.

/counters/work_item_RI.description: Counter for Request Information work items.

/counters/work_item_RQ.description: Counter for Request Quotation work items.

/counters/work_item_RA.description: Counter for Request Application work items.

/counters/work_item_RW.description: Counter for Request Website work items.

/counters/work_item_RIQ.description: Counter for Request inquiry work items.

/counters/work_item_RBS.description: Counter for Request Backend Support work items.

/counters/work_item_RO.description: Counter for Request Other work items.
